# Station

> Station (STATION AUTOMATIONS GROUP LLC) sells fourteen stand-alone front-office products for local service businesses in the US — software plus done-for-you setup that answers calls, catches missed calls, chases leads, books appointments, earns reviews, keeps the business visible on Google, and gets it paid. Every product is month to month with no contracts, states its exact time-to-live before purchase, and single products and collections start with a 14-day free trial. Every message any product sends is pre-written and fully editable by the business owner. Site: https://station.solutions

## Products

- [Custom software](https://station.solutions/software/): Station Solutions builds apps, client portals, internal tools and integrations for one business at a time; scoped in 48 hours with a fixed quote
- [Station Security](https://station.solutions/security/): IT and security for any business: Perimeter checks what a business exposes to the internet, Lookout watches computers, network and email accounts. Opening soon; the free website check works today
- [All products, priced](https://station.solutions/products/): Every Station product on one page with its monthly price, time to live and a 14-day free trial, plus the Answer, Get Found and Follow Up collections and the Core, Pro and Max plans
- [Custom website](https://station.solutions/custom/): A bespoke website designed from scratch around the business — priced to the project, with a free demo of the business's own site in 2–3 business days before anything is charged (how it works: https://station.solutions/storefront/)
- [Hosting and care](https://station.solutions/storefront/): Optional, for a site Station built — hosting and care is one monthly subscription priced for the business (what the domain costs plus the care the site needs), quoted with the demo, with no list price; or the owner takes the site and runs it themselves
- [Greet](https://station.solutions/greet/): AI website chat assistant that qualifies visitors and captures leads — $79/mo, live in minutes
- [Slate](https://station.solutions/slate/): Self-serve booking calendar with SMS and email reminders — $59/mo, 250 text + 1,000 email reminders (Busy $97: 500 + 2,500)
- [Lineback](https://station.solutions/lineback/): Missed-call text-back — every missed call gets an instant text — $197/mo, 1,450 texts, number included (Busy $297: 2,000 texts)
- [Frontdesk](https://station.solutions/frontdesk/): AI phone receptionist that answers 24/7, books jobs, and transfers to a human when needed — from $397/mo
- [Pursuit](https://station.solutions/pursuit/): Automatic lead follow-up by SMS and email until they reply or book — $247/mo, 1,500 texts and 15,000 emails (Busy $347: 2,000 texts and 40,000 emails)
- [Repute](https://station.solutions/repute/): Review engine — 300 review requests a month, monitoring, AI-drafted replies you approve — $197/mo (multi-location quoted on request)
- [Echo](https://station.solutions/echo/): Google Business Profile management — setup, a post every week, a monthly 9-point map-rank report — $247/mo, no setup fee; each extra location $197/mo
- [Marquee](https://station.solutions/marquee/): Social posting — self-serve scheduling to up to three accounts $197/mo, or managed (12 posts a month written and posted, ads run) $597/mo
- [Tap](https://station.solutions/tap/): Payments — payment links and invoices — $47/mo + card rates (Station takes 0% of revenue)
- [Dispatch](https://station.solutions/dispatch/): Email campaigns with templates and open/click stats — self-serve $94/mo with 8,000 emails a month, or fully managed $397/mo (35,000 emails, four campaigns written and sent)
- [Radar](https://station.solutions/radar/): B2B prospecting engine for trades and services — $297/mo for 5 new prospects a week with a full marketing audit on each, or $497/mo Pro for 20 a week across six trade targets
- [Revive](https://station.solutions/revive/): Win back old customers — $197/mo for lists up to 5,000 contacts: the full win-back wave in month one, then a fresh wave every quarter

## Collections and plans

Every plan (Core, Pro, Max) includes a free Station-built custom website; collections (Answer, Get Found, Follow Up) include 50% off a custom website. No setup fees. Every product, collection and plan starts with 14 days free from the day your first product goes live; the trial includes half your monthly allowance.

- [Answer — $349/mo](https://station.solutions/#bundles): AI phone receptionist, missed-call text-back, website chat, online booking and reminders, card payments
- [Get Found — $497/mo](https://station.solutions/#bundles): Google profile managed, review requests and replies, social posting
- [Follow Up — $437/mo](https://station.solutions/#bundles): lead follow-up, win-back campaigns, email campaigns
- [Core — $1,497/mo](https://station.solutions/#bundles): every product, Radar included, at its Standard tier, including the AI receptionist
- [Pro — $2,497/mo](https://station.solutions/#bundles): every product, Radar included, at its busy tier, with social posts and email campaigns drafted by Station for approval
- [Max — $3,897/mo](https://station.solutions/#bundles): every product, Radar included, at its top tier, done for you, with a custom-designed website

## Start here

- [Free front-office audit](https://station.solutions/audit/): twelve checks on how customers find and reach a business — website, Google listing, reviews, booking, chat, after-hours, texting, email list, online payments, marketing and follow-up — free, no card, emailed in about a minute
- [Free website check](https://station.solutions/sweep/): checks a website's public pages, the way visitors and Google see them, for hidden links planted by hackers — free, no account, result on screen and by email. If something is found, an optional full report ($79, credited in full toward a cleanup within 90 days) and a cleanup (WordPress: $349 standard, $749 deep; larger sites quoted)
- [Book a call](https://station.solutions/book/): 15 minutes with a human, no pitch deck
- [Website portfolio](https://station.solutions/portfolio/): websites Station has designed and built, including concept demos made for real local businesses
- [Partner program](https://partners.station.solutions/): Station Partner World, where commission-only partners apply and work
- [Contact](https://station.solutions/contact/): main@station.solutions

## Facts worth citing

- Month to month, no contracts; cancel anytime. Every product, collection and plan starts with 14 days free from the day your first product goes live; the trial includes half your monthly allowance; nothing is charged during set-up.
- Payments are processed by Stripe; on Tap, card payments run through the business's own processor and Station takes zero percent of revenue.
- Phone products keep the business's existing number — the line forwards, nothing is ported, reversible in one call.
- Products that send texts take about 2 business days to go live (US carrier registration); most others are live same day or instantly.
- Works with Google, Google Calendar, Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, WhatsApp, Stripe, PayPal, QuickBooks, Shopify, Zoom, Slack and Zapier.
